test_pairwise_distances_metrics: test faiss pairwise_distances against scipy for L1, L2, Linf, Canberra, and Jaccard metrics
test_nan_euclidean_distance: test faiss pairwise_distances with METRIC_NaNEuclidean to handle NaN values in vectors
test_gower_distance: test faiss pairwise_distances with METRIC_GOWER for mixed numeric and categorical features
test_knn_search_flat_index: test faiss IndexFlat KNN search results match pairwise_distances argmin for L1 and Linf
test_hnsw_and_ivf_indices: test faiss IndexHNSW and IndexIVFFlat search results match exact pairwise_distances for L1 metric
